metadata.description: Name of the virtual machine to provision.
DNS label prefix for the VM public IP. Defaults to VM name. The FQDN will be <prefix>.<region>.cloudapp.azure.com
Admin username for the Linux VM.
SSH public key for the admin user.
Container image source: acr (Azure Container Registry) or dockerhub (Docker Hub insilicomed)
Azure Container Registry login server (required if imageSource=acr), e.g. myregistry.azurecr.io
Container registry username (ACR token username or Docker Hub username)
Container registry password (ACR token password or Docker Hub password/token)
Optional OpenAI API key if AI features are enabled.
OpenAI API type: openai, azure, or custom.
Optional OpenAI API version when using Azure OpenAI.
Optional OpenAI deployment name when using Azure OpenAI.

Independent JSON array string for embedding model configurations (NOT auto-derived from the generic OpenAI params). Provide per‑model credentials if they differ. Example: [{"model":"text-embedding-3-small","api_key":"<key>","base_url":"https://example.openai.azure.com","version":"2024-10-01-preview","deployment_name":"text-embedding-3-small"}]  Use an empty array [] if you do not configure embeddings yet.
Size in GB of the attached data disk for PostgreSQL, Redis, logs, and static files. Should match Premium SSD tiers: 64(P6), 128(P10), 256(P15), 512(P20), 1024(P30), 2048(P40).

variables.cloudInitTemplate:
#cloud-config
package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - apt-transport-https
  - ca-certificates
  - curl
  - gnupg
  - jq
  - lsb-release
  - software-properties-common
  - docker.io

# Ensure directories needed by later write_files entries exist (write_files does not create nested dirs like /opt/dora/bin by default)
bootcmd:
  - [bash, -c, "mkdir -p /opt/dora/bin"]

write_files:
  - path: /opt/dora/docker-compose.yml
    owner: root:root
    permissions: "0644"
    content: |
      # docker compose specification (v2). 'version' key omitted (deprecated warning otherwise)
      services:
        nginx:
          image: nginx:1.25-alpine
          container_name: dora_nginx
          restart: always
          depends_on:
            - dora_backend
            - frontend
          ports:
            - "80:80"
          volumes:
            - /opt/dora/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
            - /mnt/dora-data/static:/var/www/static
          networks:
            - main

        frontend:
          image: __FRONTEND_IMAGE__
          container_name: dora_frontend
          restart: always
          depends_on:
            - dora_backend
          expose:
            - "8000"
          networks:
            - main

        dora_backend:
          image: __BACKEND_IMAGE__
          container_name: dora_backend
          restart: always
          command: /bin/sh -c "sleep 5 && python /dora/manage.py collectstatic --noinput && python /dora/manage.py migrate --noinput && uwsgi --ini /dora/deploy/uwsgi.ini --enable-threads"
          depends_on:
            - dora_db
            - dora_redis
          expose:
            - "8080"
          env_file:
            - /opt/dora/.env
          volumes:
            - /mnt/dora-data/static:/dora/static
          networks:
            - main

        dora_worker:
          image: __BACKEND_IMAGE__
          container_name: dora_backend_worker
          restart: always
          env_file:
            - /opt/dora/.env
          depends_on:
            - dora_db
            - dora_redis
          volumes:
            - /mnt/dora-data/logs:/dora/logs
          command: /bin/sh -c "sleep 10 && celery -A app worker -E -l INFO -c 4 --without-heartbeat --without-gossip --without-mingle & celery -A app worker -E -Q email -l INFO -c 1 --without-heartbeat --without-gossip --without-mingle"
          networks:
            - main

        dora_backend_ws:
          image: __BACKEND_IMAGE__
          container_name: dora_backend_ws
          restart: always
          env_file:
            - /opt/dora/.env
          expose:
            - "8081"
          depends_on:
            - dora_db
            - dora_redis
          command: /bin/sh -c "sleep 10 && daphne --bind 0.0.0.0 --port 8081 app.asgi:application"
          networks:
            - main

        dora_db:
          image: pgvector/pgvector:pg16
          container_name: dora_db
          restart: always
          expose:
            - "5432"
          environment:
            POSTGRES_USER: dora
            POSTGRES_PASSWORD: dora
            POSTGRES_DB: dora
          volumes:
            - /mnt/dora-data/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
          networks:
            - main

        dora_redis:
          image: redis:7.2.3
          container_name: dora_redis
          restart: always
          expose:
            - "6379"
          volumes:
            - /mnt/dora-data/redis:/data
          networks:
            - main

      networks:
        main:
          name: dora_network

  - path: /opt/dora/nginx.conf
    owner: root:root
    permissions: "0644"
    content: |
      server {
          listen 80;
          server_name _;
          charset utf-8;
          server_tokens off;
          client_max_body_size 0;

          location ~* /static/(admin|img|drf_spectacular_sidecar|dist|users) {
              root /var/www;
          }

          location / {
              proxy_pass http://dora_frontend:8000;
              proxy_http_version 1.1;
              proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
              proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
          }

          location ~* /(api|users|admin|openapi) {
              include uwsgi_params;
              uwsgi_pass dora_backend:8080;
              uwsgi_read_timeout 3600;
              uwsgi_send_timeout 3600;
              uwsgi_param X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
              uwsgi_param X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
              uwsgi_param X-Forwarded-Proto $http_x_forwarded_proto;
          }

          location /ws/ {
              proxy_pass http://dora_backend_ws:8081;
              proxy_http_version 1.1;
              proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
              proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
          }

          location /s3/ {
              rewrite ^/s3/(.*) /$1 break;
              proxy_pass http://dora_backend:8080;
              proxy_set_header Host dora_backend:8080;
              proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
              proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
          }

          error_page 500 502 503 504 /50x.html;
          location = /50x.html {
              root /usr/share/nginx/html;
              internal;
          }
      }

  - path: /opt/dora/.env
    owner: root:root
    permissions: "0640"
    content: |
      DEBUG=False
      SECRET_KEY=__SECRET_KEY__
      DB_NAME=dora
      DB_USER=dora
      DB_PASSWORD=dora
      DB_HOST=dora_db
      DB_PORT=5432
      DATABASE_URL=__DATABASE_URL__
      REDIS_CONN_STR=redis://dora_redis:6379
      REDIS_CACHE_DB=0
      REDIS_BROKER_DB=1
      REDIS_CHANNELS_DB=2
      REDIS_CHUNKS_DB=3
      REDIS_WEBCHUNKS_DB=4
      OPENAI_API_MODEL=gpt-5
      OPENAI_API_KEY=__OPENAI_API_KEY__
      OPENAI_API_TIMEOUT=180
      OPENAI_API_TYPE=__OPENAI_API_TYPE__
      OPENAI_API_BASE_URL=__OPENAI_API_BASE_URL__
      OPENAI_API_VERSION=__OPENAI_API_VERSION__
      OPENAI_API_DEPLOYMENT_NAME=__OPENAI_API_DEPLOYMENT_NAME__
      BACKUP_OPENAI_API_MODEL=gpt-4.1
      BACKUP_OPENAI_API_KEY=
      BACKUP_OPENAI_API_TYPE=openai
      BACKUP_OPENAI_API_BASE_URL=
      BACKUP_OPENAI_API_VERSION=
      BACKUP_OPENAI_API_DEPLOYMENT_NAME=
      MINI_OPENAI_API_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini
      MINI_OPENAI_API_KEY=
      MINI_OPENAI_API_TYPE=openai
      MINI_OPENAI_API_BASE_URL=
      MINI_OPENAI_API_VERSION=
      MINI_OPENAI_API_DEPLOYMENT_NAME=
      BACKUP_MINI_OPENAI_API_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini
      BACKUP_MINI_OPENAI_API_KEY=
      BACKUP_MINI_OPENAI_API_TYPE=openai
      BACKUP_MINI_OPENAI_API_BASE_URL=
      BACKUP_MINI_OPENAI_API_VERSION=
      BACKUP_MINI_OPENAI_API_DEPLOYMENT_NAME=
      EMBEDDING_OPENAI_API_CONFIGS=__EMBEDDING_OPENAI_API_CONFIGS__
      GENERATION_RETRY_TIMES=1
      TOOL_EXECUTION_COUNT_LIMIT=False
      TOOL_MAX_EXECUTION_COUNT=20
      AGENT_EXECUTOR_MAX_ITERATIONS=30
      DORA_PUBLIC_URL=__PUBLIC_BASE_URL__
      DORA_STATIC_URL=__PUBLIC_BASE_URL__
      GENERATION_TASK_TIMEOUT=3600
      CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=__PUBLIC_BASE_URL__
      ALLOWED_HOSTS=*
      MERMAID_SERVER_URL=https://mermaid.ink
      SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=False
      USE_PHOENIX=False
      SENTRY_DSN=
      IS_BIBLIOGRAPHY_ENABLED=True
      IS_WEBSEARCH_ENABLED=True
      STORAGE_BACKEND=blob
      AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING=__AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING__
      AZURE_STORAGE_CONTAINER=__AZURE_STORAGE_CONTAINER__
      AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME=__AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME__
      AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_KEY=
      AZURE_STORAGE_AUTO_CREATE_CONTAINER=False
      AZURE_STORAGE_DOMAIN_SUFFIX=blob.core.windows.net
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=
      S3_ENDPOINT_URL=
      AWS_STORAGE_BUCKET=
      AWS_STORAGE_REGION=

  - path: /opt/dora/bin/bootstrap.sh
    owner: root:root
    permissions: "0755"
    content: |
      #!/usr/bin/env bash
      # Idempotent DORA bootstrap (v3) with docker compose auto-install + initial data load
      set -euo pipefail
      LOG_FILE="/var/log/dora-bootstrap.log"; mkdir -p /var/log; touch "$LOG_FILE"; chmod 644 "$LOG_FILE"; exec >>"$LOG_FILE" 2>&1
      REGISTRY_SERVER="__REGISTRY_SERVER__"; REGISTRY_USERNAME="__REGISTRY_USERNAME__"; REGISTRY_PASSWORD="__REGISTRY_PASSWORD__"; ADMIN_USER="__ADMIN_USERNAME__"
      DISK_DEVICE="/dev/disk/azure/scsi1/lun0"; DATA_MOUNT="/mnt/dora-data"; DOCKER_DIR="/opt/dora"; COMPOSE_FILE="/opt/dora/docker-compose.yml"
      DEFAULT_USER_EMAIL="dora@test.com"; INITIAL_DATA_TIMEOUT=${INITIAL_DATA_MAX_WAIT_SECONDS:-600}
      log(){ echo "$(date --iso-8601=seconds) $*"; }
      if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q '^dora_nginx$'; then log "Stack already running"; exit 0; fi
      ensure_docker(){ if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then log "Installing docker"; curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | bash; fi; systemctl enable docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; systemctl start docker || true; }
      ensure_compose(){ if docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then return; fi; log "Installing compose"; if ! apt-get update -y || ! apt-get install -y docker-compose-plugin; then mkdir -p /usr/lib/docker/cli-plugins; curl -SL https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/v2.29.2/docker-compose-linux-x86_64 -o /usr/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose; chmod +x /usr/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose; fi; docker compose version || { log "Compose install failed"; exit 1; }; }
      ensure_disk(){ if [ ! -b "$DISK_DEVICE" ]; then log "No data disk"; return 0; fi; if ! blkid "$DISK_DEVICE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then log "Formatting data disk"; mkfs.ext4 -F "$DISK_DEVICE"; fi; mkdir -p "$DATA_MOUNT"; if ! mountpoint -q "$DATA_MOUNT"; then mount "$DISK_DEVICE" "$DATA_MOUNT" || log "Mount failed"; fi; uuid=$(blkid -s UUID -o value "$DISK_DEVICE" || true); if [ -n "${uuid:-}" ] && ! grep -q "$uuid" /etc/fstab; then echo "UUID=$uuid $DATA_MOUNT ext4 defaults,nofail 0 2" >> /etc/fstab; fi; mkdir -p "$DATA_MOUNT/postgres" "$DATA_MOUNT/redis" "$DATA_MOUNT/logs" "$DATA_MOUNT/static"; chown 999:999 "$DATA_MOUNT/postgres" || true; chown 999:999 "$DATA_MOUNT/redis" || true; chmod 775 "$DATA_MOUNT/logs" "$DATA_MOUNT/static" || true; }
      prepare_env(){ mkdir -p "$DOCKER_DIR" "$DOCKER_DIR/bin"; chmod 755 "$DOCKER_DIR" "$DOCKER_DIR/bin"; usermod -aG docker "$ADMIN_USER" || true; [ -f "$DOCKER_DIR/.env" ] && chown root:docker "$DOCKER_DIR/.env" && chmod 640 "$DOCKER_DIR/.env" || true; }
      login_registry(){ log "Registry login to $REGISTRY_SERVER"; docker login "$REGISTRY_SERVER" -u "$REGISTRY_USERNAME" -p "$REGISTRY_PASSWORD" 1>/dev/null || { log "Registry login failed"; exit 1; }; }
      start_stack(){ [ -f "$COMPOSE_FILE" ] || { log "Compose file missing"; exit 1; }; log "Pull images"; docker compose -f "$COMPOSE_FILE" pull || true; log "Up stack"; docker compose -f "$COMPOSE_FILE" up -d; docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}'; }
      load_initial_data(){
        if [ "${SKIP_INITIAL_DATA:-0}" = "1" ]; then log "[initdata] Skipping (SKIP_INITIAL_DATA=1)"; return 0; fi
        log "[initdata] Waiting for backend (timeout ${INITIAL_DATA_TIMEOUT}s)"; local start=$(date +%s)
        while true; do
          if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q '^dora_backend$' && docker exec dora_backend sh -c "python -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.settimeout(1); r=s.connect_ex((\"127.0.0.1\",8080)); s.close(); exit(r)'" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi
          now=$(date +%s); if [ $((now-start)) -ge $INITIAL_DATA_TIMEOUT ]; then log "[initdata] Timeout waiting backend"; return 0; fi; sleep 5
        done
        log "[initdata] Backend port ready. Waiting additional 10s for app initialization";
        sleep 10
        log "[initdata] Checking default user ${DEFAULT_USER_EMAIL}";
        if docker compose -f "$COMPOSE_FILE" exec -T dora_backend python manage.py shell -c "from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model as g; import sys; sys.exit(0 if g().objects.filter(email='${DEFAULT_USER_EMAIL}').exists() else 1)"; then
          log "[initdata] User exists. Skip load"; return 0; fi
        log "[initdata] Loading initial_data.json";
        if docker compose -f "$COMPOSE_FILE" exec -T dora_backend python manage.py loaddata initial_data.json; then log "[initdata] Load done"; else log "[initdata] Load failed"; return 1; fi
        if docker compose -f "$COMPOSE_FILE" exec -T dora_backend python manage.py shell -c "from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model as g; import sys; sys.exit(0 if g().objects.filter(email='${DEFAULT_USER_EMAIL}').exists() else 1)"; then
          log "[initdata] Verification success"; else log "[initdata] Verification failed"; fi
      }
      log "=== BOOTSTRAP BEGIN ==="; ensure_docker; ensure_compose; ensure_disk; prepare_env; login_registry; start_stack; load_initial_data; log "=== BOOTSTRAP END ===";

runcmd:
  - [bash, -c, "systemctl daemon-reload || true"]
  - [bash, /opt/dora/bin/bootstrap.sh]
  - [
      bash,
      -c,
      'if [ ! -f /var/log/dora-bootstrap.log ]; then echo "[cloud-init] bootstrap log missing; check /var/log/cloud-init.log" >&2; fi',
    ]

osProfile.customData: [base64(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(variables('cloudInitWithSecret'), '__AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING__', format('DefaultEndpointsProtocol=https;AccountName={0};AccountKey={1};EndpointSuffix={2}', variables('storageAccountName'), listKeys('storageAccount', '2023-01-01').keys[0].value, environment().suffixes.storage)), '__AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME__', variables('storageAccountName')), '__AZURE_STORAGE_CONTAINER__', 'media'), '__OPENAI_API_KEY__', parameters('openAiApiKey')), '__OPENAI_API_TYPE__', parameters('openAiApiType')), '__OPENAI_API_BASE_URL__', parameters('openAiApiBaseUrl')), '__OPENAI_API_VERSION__', parameters('openAiApiVersion')), '__OPENAI_API_DEPLOYMENT_NAME__', parameters('openAiDeploymentName')), '__ADMIN_USERNAME__', parameters('adminUsername')), '__EMBEDDING_OPENAI_API_CONFIGS__', parameters('embeddingOpenAiApiConfigs')), '__REGISTRY_USERNAME__', parameters('registryUsername')), '__REGISTRY_PASSWORD__', parameters('registryPassword')), '__PUBLIC_BASE_URL__', format('http://{0}', reference('publicIpAddress').dnsSettings.fqdn)), '__DATABASE_URL__', variables('databaseUrl')))]
